name: DB Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating throughout South Korea, DB Insurance Co., Ltd. furnishes a wide array of insurance policies and related services. Its product portfolio includes general, automobile, and long-term insurance options, notably under its Promy car and Promy life brand names. Originally known as Dongbu Insurance Co., Ltd., the company officially adopted its present name, DB Insurance Co., Ltd., in November 2017. This enterprise, founded in 1962 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, operates as a component of the larger DB Group.
